review:
A compact 4x6 fruit-style game set in a golden vault of coins and banknotes. Pragmatic keeps the description short: classic fruit symbols, and wilds that can spring surprises.

The in-game info advertises up to 5,000x, which is high for such a traditional-looking game – so the wilds clearly matter more than the retro look suggests. 96.52% RTP. The best way to judge it is a few hundred demo spins to see how often the wilds land. For fans of simple lines over tumbles and clusters.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
